title: Sounding out short words one sound at a time
examples: How do I sound out a word?

explain.say: Look at the word cat on the board. It has 3 letters. Each letter makes one sound. You will say each sound, one at a time.

draw.text: Sounding out short words one sound at a time

explain.say: Look at the first letter. It is c. Here it makes the first sound in kite. Tap your shoulder and say that sound.
Look at the middle letter. It is a. It makes the first sound in apple. Tap your elbow and say that sound.

Look at the last letter. It is t. It makes the first sound in tiger. Tap your hand and say that sound. Now say the 3 sounds again, a bit faster. Slide your hand down your arm. You can hear the word cat.
Here is a new word, next to the sun picture. Tap one sound for each letter. Then slide your hand down your arm to blend. What word is it? Today, sound out 3 short words with a grown-up.

faq.a: It means saying each sound in a word, one at a time. Then you push the sounds together until you hear the word.
asks: How do I sound out a word?

faq.q: Why do I tap my arm?
faq.a: Tapping gives each sound its own place. Your hands and ears work together, and that helps you remember the sounds.
Blending means joining sounds together. Say them again, a bit faster each time, until you hear one word.
asks: How do I join the sounds?

faq.q: What if I get a sound wrong?
faq.a: That is fine, everybody does. Go back to the first sound and try again, nice and steady. A teacher or grown-up can say the sounds with you.

faq.q: Which words are best to start with?
faq.a: Start with three-letter words like cat, sun, pig, hop and bed. Each letter makes one sound, so they are perfect for practice.

facts: The word cat has three letters and three sounds.
Words like cat, sun and pig are often called CVC words: consonant, vowel, consonant.

quiz.say: How many sounds are in the word sun?
quiz.show: ☀️ How many sounds are in sun?
quiz.why: Sun has 3 sounds, one for each letter.

wrong.0: Tap once for each letter in sun, and you get 3 taps.
wrong.2: Sun has 3 letters, and each letter makes 1 sound.

quiz.say: You say each sound. What do you do next?
quiz.why: Blending joins the sounds. You say them faster until you hear the word.

wrong.0: A guess can give the wrong word, so blend the sounds you said.
wrong.1: You already have the sounds, so you can blend them and read it.
